For more than four decades, Orodjarstvo Križaj has been a leader among small Slovenian companies in the production of high-quality tools for aluminum die casting, including cutting tools. Recently, we have expanded our offering to include the OK Design Department, which goes beyond traditional toolmaking. Our commitment to innovation and expertise, supported by close links with institutes and academic institutions, enables us to better meet the research, development and production needs of our customers.

entityName: Glowny Urzad Geodezji i Kartografii (Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography)
entityDescription:
Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography of Poland (GUGiK) is a national mapping agency.
The role of Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography is to provide access to current geodetic and cartographic information andco-creating a modern spatial data infrastructure. The tasks carried out by Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography result mainly from two basic legal acts:
- Act of 17 May1989 on geodetic and cartographic law.

- Act of 4 March 2010 on spatial information infrastructure.
The most important tasks of GUGiK include:
- supervising realisation of the national policy in the scope of land surveying and cartography,
- maintaining theNational Geodetic and Cartographic Resources,
- maintaining records in the systems of information on lands with general state importance,
- granting professional qualifications in the area of land surveying and cartography,
- creating and maintaining the geoportal of spatial information, as the central access point for services (such as searching, reviewing, downloading and transforming) within a full thematic and territorial range of infrastructure,
- being responsible for contacts with the European Commission.The Surveyor General of Poland has been appointed as the National Contact Point on issues relating to the INSPIRE Directive.

entityDescription:
MediaTek is a fabless semiconductor company, which is another way of saying we design chips for electronic devices that our partners manufacture.
We design cutting-edge system-on-chip (SoC) solutions for cellular handsets and tablet devices; fixed and wireless connectivity; high-definition TV; optical storage and DVD and Blu-ray products.
MediaTek is headquartered in Taiwan and has sales and research subsidiaries in mainland China, Singapore, India, U.S., Japan, South Korea, Denmark, the UK, Sweden and Dubai. Our R&D centre in Cambourne (near Cambridge) develops smartphone SW and cellular system technology, and our R&D centre in Kent develops RF technology. MTK Wireless Ltd is the UK operation of MediaTek Inc. In the UK, we have two R&D centers – both working on technology for our future SoC wireless chipsets. Our R&D centre in Cambourne (near Cambridge) develops SW and system technology, and our R&D centre in Kent develops RF technology
MediaTek'sWirelessProducts
MediaTek has cumulatively shipped well over 2.5Bn cellular chipsets since entering the cellular market segment less than a decade ago. MediaTek’s “total solution” turnkey approach, and insatiable appetite for excellence in modem solutions, has enabled our customers to successfully deploy MediaTek powered handsets in over 150 countries worldwide. Most recently, our 3G chipsets have been at the forefront of enabling the democratization of smartphones for the mass market. In addition to cellular chipsets, MediaTek has developed leading edge wireless connectivity technology, including Wi-Fi, BT GPS and NFC.
MediaTek in Finland

MediaTek Finland focuses in 5G/6G modem chipset development, containing embedded system SW development, algorithm and HW design as well as modem integration and verification. MediaTek Finland has close co-operation with European network vendors and mobile network operators and participates also to 3GPP specification work.

description: Arceon develops ceramic matrix composite materials and structures.
entityDescription: Arceon B.V. is an engineering company located in the Netherlands, focussed on the research, development and application of ceramic matrix composite materials. The company consists of a strong team of engineers, and an in-house manufacturing capability. Ceramic matrix composite materials (CMCs) are a combination of ceramics and composites, utilizing the advantages of both. Like polymer composites, they use reinforcing fibres like carbon or silicon carbide to provide strength and stiffness. The matrix consists of a ceramic, usually silicon carbide, which provides high temperature performance and ablative resistance. Arceon uses carbon fibres in a silicon carbide matrix, which results in attractive material properties: low density (1.9-2.1 g/cm3 ), high temperature resistance (stable up to at least 1600 °C), low CTE (-1 – 2.5 10-6 K -1 ) and high strength (flexural strength up to 300 MPa). Also, by using different fibres and additives, many of the properties can be tailored to specific applications.
